name: web-mirror
description: Mirror any webpage to a local server for offline access. Uses Playwright and BeautifulSoup to crawl and download web pages, including video content, with link rewriting for local browsing. Pair with an nginx container to serve the mirrored content locally. More info: https://github.com/GeiserX/web-mirror

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Directory to store mirrored web pages and assets
